sources.snippet: the Ed25519 signature verifies the exact manifest bytes Layerfault parsed; the attestation names the same canonical model identity being scanned; it records the same manifest digest; the signing key is present, active and not revoked in the local trust store; and the key is explicitly authorized for that model identity/namespace.
